title: Empirical Bifurcation Boundary & Late-Onset Recovery Separatrix
caption: (a) Empirical escape probability as a function of compositional pressure lambda for the canonical Transformer 2L on H-Bar (n=30 seeds/cell), showing a sharp step transition at hat{lambda}_crit = 0.025. (b) 2D late-onset recovery heatmap over the (lambda, t_int) plane demonstrating 100% escape for supercritical pressure even after late-onset intervention.
